summary: Sherwin-Williams filed an 8-K reporting that on September 24, 2026 it entered a new 364-day senior unsecured term loan credit agreement with Citibank as administrative agent and lenders, providing a $750 million USD term loan maturing September 23, 2027. Proceeds refinance the prior 364-day delayed draw term loan dated August 8, 2025 and fund general corporate purposes including working capital. Covenants mirror the prior facility; the consolidated leverage ratio cap is 3.75x, step-up to 4.25x for four quarters after a Qualifying Acquisition. No board recommendation or advisor is named; watch covenant headroom and any acquisition step-up.
